lessons.title: Sharing Opinions

items.example: Acho que a comida é deliciosa.
items.exampleMeaning: I think that the food is delicious.

items.example: Eu gostei do filme.
items.exampleMeaning: I liked the movie.

items.example: Foi interessante aprender sobre a cultura.
items.exampleMeaning: It was interesting to learn about the culture.

items.example: Não gostei da música.
items.exampleMeaning: I didn't like the music.

items.example: Achei bonito o pôr do sol.
items.exampleMeaning: I found the sunset beautiful.

items.example: Foi legal ir ao parque.
items.exampleMeaning: It was cool to go to the park.

lessons.tip: In Portuguese, you express your opinion using phrases like 'Acho que' (I think that) or 'Eu gostei' (I liked). Remember to use the past tense for experiences you are sharing.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: O que você achou do filme?
dialogue.meaning: What did you think of the movie?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I liked it a lot!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: It was interesting, right?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, it was cool!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And the music?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I didn't like it much.

scenario.partnerRole: A friend discussing a movie and music with the learner.
scenario.learnerRole: You are sharing your opinions about the movie and music.
scenario.brief: Ask your friend what they thought about the movie and share your thoughts. Discuss the music too.
scenario.goal: You need to express your opinions clearly.

lessons.title: Likes and Dislikes in the Past

items.example: Eu amei a festa.
items.exampleMeaning: I loved the party.

items.example: Não gostei de ficar em casa.
items.exampleMeaning: I didn't like staying at home.

items.example: Foi maravilhoso viajar para o Brasil.
items.exampleMeaning: It was wonderful to travel to Brazil.

items.example: Eu detestei aquele filme.
items.exampleMeaning: I hated that movie.

items.example: Eu preferi a comida italiana.
items.exampleMeaning: I preferred the Italian food.

items.example: Foi chato esperar por horas.
items.exampleMeaning: It was boring to wait for hours.

lessons.tip: Use 'Eu amei' (I loved) for positive experiences and 'Eu detestei' (I hated) for negative ones. This helps to express your feelings about past events.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How was the party?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I loved it! It was wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And the movie?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I hated it. It was boring.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Did you prefer the food?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, eu preferi a comida italiana.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I preferred the Italian food.

scenario.partnerRole: A friend talking about a recent party and movie with the learner.
scenario.learnerRole: You are sharing your likes and dislikes about the party and movie.
scenario.brief: Discuss the party and movie you both attended. Share what you loved and hated.
scenario.goal: You need to express your likes and dislikes in the past.

lessons.title: Discussing Experiences

items.example: Eu viajei para o Brasil no ano passado.
items.exampleMeaning: I traveled to Brazil last year.

items.example: Foi incrível ver as montanhas.
items.exampleMeaning: It was amazing to see the mountains.

items.example: Eu experimentei a comida típica.
items.exampleMeaning: I tried the typical food.

items.example: Eu gostei mais de visitar as praias.
items.exampleMeaning: I liked more visiting the beaches.

items.example: Foi uma experiência única.
items.exampleMeaning: It was a unique experience.

items.example: Eu aprendi muito sobre a cultura.
items.exampleMeaning: I learned a lot about the culture.

lessons.tip: Use 'Eu viajei' (I traveled) to share your experiences. You can express how you felt about these experiences using phrases like 'Foi incrível' (It was amazing).

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Did you travel last year?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, eu viajei para o Brasil.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I traveled to Brazil.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How was it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Foi incrível! Eu experimentei a comida típica.
dialogue.meaning: It was amazing! I tried the typical food.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What did you learn?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Eu aprendi muito sobre a cultura.
dialogue.meaning: I learned a lot about the culture.

scenario.partnerRole: A friend asking about the learner's travel experiences.
scenario.learnerRole: You are sharing your travel experiences and what you learned.
scenario.brief: Talk about your travels and what you experienced. Share what you learned during your trip.
scenario.goal: You need to discuss your travel experiences clearly.

lessons.title: Reflecting on Opinions

items.example: Eu pensei que a comida seria melhor.
items.exampleMeaning: I thought that the food would be better.

items.example: Foi surpreendente ver a cidade.
items.exampleMeaning: It was surprising to see the city.

items.example: Eu não esperava que fosse tão bonito.
items.exampleMeaning: I didn't expect it to be so beautiful.

items.example: Eu achei que o show foi incrível.
items.exampleMeaning: I found that the show was amazing.

items.example: Foi uma surpresa encontrar você aqui.
items.exampleMeaning: It was a surprise to find you here.

items.example: Eu fiquei feliz com a visita.
items.exampleMeaning: I was happy with the visit.

lessons.tip: Use 'Eu pensei que' (I thought that) to reflect on your expectations. This helps to express your feelings about past experiences.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você pensou que o show seria bom?
dialogue.meaning: Did you think the show would be good?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, eu pensei que seria incrível.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I thought it would be amazing.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: It was surprising, wasn't it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, eu não esperava que fosse tão bonito.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I didn't expect it to be so beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você ficou feliz com a visita?
dialogue.meaning: Were you happy with the visit?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I was happy!

scenario.partnerRole: A friend reflecting on a recent show and visit with the learner.
scenario.learnerRole: You are sharing your thoughts about the show and how you felt during the visit.
scenario.brief: Discuss your thoughts about the show and the visit. Share your feelings and surprises.
scenario.goal: You need to reflect on your opinions and experiences.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: O que você achou do filme?
dialogue.meaning: What did you think of the movie?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I liked it a lot! It was cool.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Did you travel last year?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, eu viajei para o Brasil. Foi incrível!
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I traveled to Brazil. It was amazing!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And the music?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I didn't like it much. I hated it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: O que você aprendeu na viagem?
dialogue.meaning: What did you learn on the trip?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Eu aprendi muito sobre a cultura.
dialogue.meaning: I learned a lot about the culture.

scenario.partnerRole: A friend discussing various experiences with the learner.
scenario.learnerRole: You are sharing your opinions and experiences about movies, travel, and music.
scenario.brief: Discuss your thoughts on a movie, your travel experiences, and your feelings about music.
scenario.goal: You need to express your opinions and experiences clearly.
